sharing_corroboration.note: Transition counters are implementation-specific and are not compared as portable semantics.

decision.reason: Two sharing-capable controls complete the frozen workload with identical portable observations while pure CBN shows severe resource amplification.
decision.next: Implement NEX-written encodeU/decodeU and self term-wire processing using the same frozen representation; preserve CBN resource outcomes and sharing controls as separate evidence.

interpretation: The N-only representation remains an executable expressiveness construction.
Pure CBN is operationally poor on several small encoded values under the declared budgets.
Both Python and Go call-by-need controls complete all 37 frozen cases with identical portable observations.
This corroborates sharing as an engineering feasibility condition for the current representation.
The result does not prove NEX-specific CBN/call-by-need equivalence and does not establish a Core defect.
